content: Ila isa hatugulu mo lal yai luluwal le itowol buyoy iremi fael sew bo ide hatayikofa dipmi.
Bo hare ibe hatayikofa dipmi, ila ngo itey le yebe chil ma hacchahse lal depey? Ye tugul le rechokwe chog isa hatayikofa lal deper.

Ila fal le itafawey babior we iremi iyang. Ite dipli ibe buyoy iremi ye sala tayikof depey irer rechokla ir mele rebe hamomayu lal depey. Ye tugul lal depey le ibe rraey, ngo pangami ngo habe wol rraey.
Iteftafwey babior iremi luwul kkelel weresel depey mo luwul yai tetang, le te fael mala ibe hatayikofa dipmi, bo fael mala habe gola lepal kkelel yai hachangugmi.
Sibe Hachuya Mo Lal Depach Tayikof La Semal Ye Foru
Hare semal le ye hatayikofa depel semal, ngo te ngang mele ye hatayikofa depey bo hami — hare tot hami. (Isor mele bo fael mala ite dipli la ibe haweresiy yeramtala.)
Sa lap hagerger la hami hasa fang ngal yeramtala.
Igla ila ye momay le habe hachuya mekla yesa foru mo lal yami luluwal. Habe hakkela lal depal bo yebe yedamgel bo de paog repiyal.
Ila ikekefael pechehmi bo habe foru le yeramtala yebe gola le hami ha chil hachangi.
Itefawey babior we iremi ibe gola igegmi irel hagelgel we ye holahmi ngo igula hare ha chil ma talenga meka ikangalugmi.

Yodla habe hachuya mo lal yami luluwal tayikof la semal sa foru, ngo wol ila sengay bo ibe hachuya mo lal yai luluwal. Yodka ima hachuya mo lal yai luluwal tayikof kala semal sa foru — ngo ima foru mo fael metal Kristus bo yaglugmi.
Ima foru mele bo fael mala de yor kelel Satan uwoch, bo gich si gula mekla wegdegel Satan.
Ye Tafel Depel Paulus Mo Woal Troas
Ila hola doh Troas ibe foloyu Hapatpat Momay we kofael Kristus, ngo isala gola le Samol yesa hafel yalepal yai be foloyu Hapatpat Momay le.
Iwe ngo ye tafel lal depey irel molwe ila tuwiri Titus we bisich. Iwe isa habungur yarmat mo loboswe iwe ngo isa loh woal Macedonia.
Siya Win Irel Kristus

Iwe ngo ligdi bo sibe kangalu Deus yal hachigchig. Bo Deus yesa foru le Kristus yebe kkel mo imol mala kkelel molfid. Iwe ngo gich sibe dabey Kristus irel yodla yesa win. Deus yesa tapeligich bo sibe kaptaloh kofael Kristus bo yarmat rebe gola; yebe medarloh kaptal le be wochog yal medarloh sew bol formel le ye momay.
Bo gich ila siya wochog bo incense kala Kristus ye teptap maligach ngal Deus, le ye medarloh mala bol luwullur rechokla rebe daor mo luwullur rechokla re towe daor.

Mele ila be wochog sew bol formel kowe sima mes iyang ngalir rechoka re towe daor. Iwe ngo be wochog sew bol formel le ye momay le ma hasidoh molow ngalir rechoka rebe daor. Itey semal le be yoh ngali yengang le iye sengal?

Gich ila site wochog rechokla rema kapta mala yalol Deus le ye wochog bo sew formel le tor pelal. Gich ila Deus mele ye hagloyugich. Ila fal le sima kapta mekla ye katos mo fael metael Deus, bo yagel mala gich ila lol Kristus re hagloy.
